t: The Slave Trade Act, which banned the export of slaves from the United States, was signed by George Washington
War of the Pyrenees: France regained nearly all the land it lost to Spain the previous year with its victory in the Second Battle of Boulou.
French Revolution: Maximilien Robespierre established the Cult of the Supreme Being as the new state religion of the French First Republic.
French Revolutionary Wars: A British fleet captured six French ships of the line in a naval battle off Ushant that came to be known as the Glorious First of June.
The Battle of Trippstadt between French forces and those of Prussia and Austria began.
French Revolutionary Wars: Two British ships were intercepted by a French squadron, leading to the French seizure of HMS Alexander.
The United States and Great Britain signed the Jay Treaty, the basis for ten years of peaceful trade between the two nations.
